messages:
nina: Heads-up from support: user reported confusing phrasing in the v2 migration guide around "model alias" fallbacks. The paragraph suggests aliases are automatic but doesn't clearly state that only Dedicated can opt into alias compatibility. Support had to explain it multiple times.

omar: That's bad. Where exactly?

nina: Under migration -> compatibility section. Current line: 'Aliases will continue to resolve to equivalent model names' which is misleading. Propose we change to: 'Aliases are not automatically supported in hosted v2. Dedicated deployments can enable alias compatibility; see instructions below.' Also add a short callout in the migration quickstart and a sample curl showing explicit model name.

kevin: I can update the migration page and add a short snippet. Also will sweep the SDK examples for any "model_alias" keys. If we find any, convert to explicit model names and add a comment about alias compatibility.

nina: Please add a small troubleshooting subsection: 'If you see errors mentioning model_alias, replace with the explicit model value or enable alias compatibility on Dedicated. Contact support if unsure.'

omar: For QA, let's add a tiny docs test: grep for "model_alias" across the docs site and fail CI if found (except in the new migration page where we document it). I'll add the CI job in the docs repo.

docs-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4781 - title: "docs: clarify alias compatibility in v2 migration guide" (assignee: kevin)

ci-bot: CI started for PR #4781

kevin: PR includes: text change, new troubleshooting subsection, explicit curl snippet, and updated examples note.

ci-bot: CI passed for PR #4781

nina: Merged. Thanks. I updated the support playbook to reference the updated doc anchor so support agents can paste the correct explanation.

kevin: Will follow up with examples PR if grep finds other hits.
__metadata_note: All values are strings or list of strings. Messages concatenated into one thread string per agents.md.
